mapper.select: SELECT space_id AS spaceId, space_id AS objId, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage_detail WHERE call_time >= #{start} AND call_time < #{end} GROUP BY space_id

SELECT t.space_id AS spaceId, t.document_id AS objId, COALESCE(SUM(d.input_tokens + d.output_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage_detail d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE d.call_time >= #{start} AND d.call_time < #{end} GROUP BY t.space_id, t.document_id

SELECT space_id AS spaceId, task_id AS objId, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage_detail WHERE call_time >= #{start} AND call_time < #{end} GROUP BY space_id, task_id

SELECT space_id AS spaceId, agent_id AS objId, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) AS tokens FROM token_usage_detail WHERE call_time >= #{start} AND call_time < #{end} GROUP BY space_id, agent_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS recordCount, SUM(d.input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(d.output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(d.estimated_cost) AS estimatedCost, COUNT(DISTINCT d.task_id) AS taskCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingInputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.output_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingOutputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.estimated_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingCostCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.input_tokens_estimated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedInputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.output_tokens_estimated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedOutputCount FROM token_usage_detail d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE

SELECT DATE(d.call_time) AS usageDate, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, SUM(d.input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(d.output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(d.estimated_cost) AS estimatedCost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.input_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingInputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.output_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingOutputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.estimated_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missingCostCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.input_tokens_estimated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedInputCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.output_tokens_estimated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedOutputCount FROM token_usage_detail d JOIN task t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE GROUP BY DATE(d.call_time) ORDER BY DATE(d.call_time)
